PLAN "Pregnancy Strength (Weeks 1-12)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and function"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower + core (upright core)":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full body single-leg focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower + core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          good_morning 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full body stability":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_floor 5m
    WEEK 3:
